title: Large personal Amiga assets, CPC, C64 and Atari ST discovery
summary: Personally screen 129 candidate URLs and add 29 projects, with one unimplemented-tool exclusion and one unavailable-artifact deferral.
notes: Root assistant performed all research and main-branch publication without a worker, PR or new branch. Eight searches covered graphics/asset tools, Atari source, Apple disassembly, Commodore media, Spectrum analysis and CPC editors. BBC searches also returned unrelated micro:bit projects, which were screened out rather than described as BBC Micro software. Primary documentation and implementation were inspected for every addition. Toolchain, historical RTOS, PPC-only and partial-emulation limits are explicit. AI attribution uses stated contributions, not prose style or agent configuration. The ZX-REAPER root is a staged analysis harness with both memory-model and clean-state examples; no game-specific emulator is promoted as a completed native reconstruction. No upstream code, firmware, drive operation or network service was executed. Large or legacy-encoded primary files remain immutable links when not suitable for inline proofs. Build and runtime claims remain unverified unless expressly documented.

sources.reason: Host graphics suite includes palette-range merging and sprite conversion/compression components; palette implementation and component documentation inspected.
Command-line PPM/SCR conversion and native datatype-driven GUI variants for Spectrum graphics; generated PortablE C++ conversion source inspected.
Palette remapping, gradients, raster and fade generation exports 68k data; ST/STE/Amiga quantization implementations present.
Original 4K intro source dump with effect, music, debug and packing code, not a new binary reconstruction.
Palo Alto Tiny BASIC adaptation to RTOS-UH with native interpreter and PEARL interface source.
Historical disk editor exposes FDC/DMA operations through native assembly and PEARL interfaces.
Circular and sector visualizations expose GCR track gaps, sync marks and missing headers/data.
Native disk-filename database supports directory reading, sorting, disk IDs and printing; assembly sort/helper routines inspected.
Object Pascal image parser covers D64/D71/D81 geometry and files, with CLI, macOS browser and QuickLook sources.
BASIC 3.5 diagnostics inspect TCBM paddle/interface and drive mechanism; includes tokenizer and lint/test tooling.
Catalogue/extract/checksum tools normalize GEOS CVT records for comparison, with concrete geometry and chain-reading implementation.
Agent-guided harness combines annotated disassembly, routine differential checks, memory-layout Python ports and subsequent clean-state game rewrites; inspected Hungry Horace movement logic.
Partial Spectrum emulator logs per-instruction register/memory state and compares runs to supply Ghidra comments.
Tk editor handles tile maps, metadata, entities and platform palette/screen constraints.
Love2D editor implements CPC mode-zero pixel packing and sprite/title-screen editing across retained development versions.
M4 WiFi terminal couples a background ROM and RAM-resident core with host console/GUI and screen/file tooling.
Two-pass Z80 assembler emits binary, symbols, relocation data and TAP loaders; also includes PNG-to-SCR and sprite editing.
Node library exposes FORM/LIST/CAT/PROP structures plus ILBM and SMUS helpers and ByteRun unpacking.
RGB image conversion performs shared-palette processing, optional dithering and Amiga ILBM or PNG/palette export.
Small in-memory chunk-structure parser with listing and WAV examples; caller-owned buffers are referenced rather than copied.
KDE thumbnail plugin reads ILBM aspect information and uses ImageMagick for resized image display.
ILBM reader exports raw/ACE-oriented planar data, palettes and masks with interleaved/noninterleaved paths.
Windows sample editor/converter supports WAV/MP3, 8SVX, loops and ProTracker tuning; Fibonacci-delta load/encode routines inspected.
Player and separate decoder libraries handle legacy animation frames and CDXL audio/video; decoder implementation inspected.
Rust converter preserves indexed-image workflow while packing pixels into IFF bitplanes.
Swift package decodes ILBM chunks, palettes and compressed bitplanes to a CGImage usable as NSImage.
Python/Pillow converter writes ILBM bitplanes, chunks and ByteRun-style compression from indexed PNG.
Aseprite Lua script imports/exports basic ILBM/LBM with explicitly limited special-mode and cycling support.
Native drawing superclass and DR2D/SVG datatype implementations provide structured vector-art loading/rendering.
README proposes a D64-to-drive transfer utility, but the complete implementation only parses help/version/baud options and exits. No image or transfer operation is implemented.

The current tree contains only README and FILE_ID.DIZ and announces the project paused/private. Recover a public author release or source snapshot to verify the cataloguing implementation before making a technical record.
